description: This file contains unit tests for the Qbone session in the quiche QUIC implementation, including setup of client and server sessions, handshake procedures, data transmission, and control request handling.

classes.name: IndirectionProofSource
classes.description: A mock proof source for testing, providing fake cryptographic proofs.

classes.name: IndirectionProofVerifier
classes.description: A mock proof verifier for testing, simulating server credential verification.

classes.name: DataSavingQbonePacketWriter
classes.description: A packet writer that saves written packets into a vector for inspection.

classes.name: DataSavingQboneControlHandler
classes.description: A control handler that records requests and errors for testing.

classes.name: FakeTaskRunner
classes.description: A mock task runner that schedules and runs tasks in simulated time order.

classes.name: QboneSessionTest
classes.description: Test fixture for Qbone session tests, setting up client/server sessions, handshake, and data flow tests.

methods.name: TestPacketIn
methods.description: Creates a test IPv6 packet with specified body for input.

methods.name: TestPacketOut
methods.description: Creates a test IPv6 packet with specified body for output.

methods.name: GetTestParams
methods.description: Returns supported QUIC versions with message frame support for testing.

methods.name: CreateClientAndServerSessions
methods.description: Sets up mock client and server QUIC sessions with optional handshake success and ALPN configuration.

methods.name: StartHandshake
methods.description: Initiates handshake process between client and server sessions.

methods.name: TestStreamConnection
methods.description: Tests data exchange over a QUIC connection, including large payloads and ICMP responses.

methods.name: TestDisconnectAfterFailedHandshake
methods.description: Verifies that sessions are disconnected after handshake failure.

methods.name: ExpectICMPTooBigResponse
methods.description: Checks if ICMP 'Packet Too Big' responses are sent correctly.
